embeds.title: 🔴 AntV Data Visualization Tool Hit by npm Supply Chain Attack
embeds.description:
**Actor:** TeamPCP
The npm registry was compromised in an attack targeting the AntV enterprise data visualization tool. Attackers compromised the credentials of a high-value npm maintainer account (atool) and published at least 637 malicious versions across 317 different npm packages in a 22-minute burst. The malware, identified as Mini-Shai-Hulud worm, steals npm and GitHub tokens, credentials from 130 file paths, and exfiltrates data to public GitHub repositories. The attack was attributed to TeamPCP. AntV's maintainers issued warnings and advised users to audit and move to known safe versions.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🟢 3 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Compromised npm maintainer account credentials
**Incident date:** 2026-05-19 • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4173291/antv-data-visualization-tool-the-latest-to-be-hit-by-ongoing-npm-supply-chain-attacks-2.html)
